brief_rationale: The doctor promptly escalated the new right-eye pressure/blurred vision in the setting of a right nasal cavity mass, gave same-day ED/ENT pathways, and repeatedly maintained emergency red-flag boundaries. The trajectory correctly avoided equating “肿物/肿瘤” with cancer, pursued/verified available records and pathology through the patient and hospital teams, and converted work, family, cost, and transport barriers into executable steps. No responsibility-chain error is evident, and multiple high-order points were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact, supporting grade 5.

closure_assessment.explanation: The episode closes as a safe transition: pathology is interpreted cautiously, residual uncertainty about complete excision and imaging is carried to ENT follow-up, persistent eye symptoms have an ophthalmology plan, and urgent deterioration triggers ED care. The patient’s final teach-back confirms the plan and red flags.
